card.name: Gap before a plural noun after modifier
card.fires_on: The space or the start of 'sub' right after a modifier, where a plural noun like things, products, groups or -tasks is expected next. Seen in general web prose, often within lists or coordinated phrases.

modes.label: Space before noun
modes.description: A bare space after an adjective or noun modifier, with a plural noun due next.
